_comment: Main sitespeed.io configuration file. All CLI options can be expressed here as JSON keys.

browsertime._comment: browsertime controls the browser-level capture settings.

plugins._comment: List of sitespeed.io plugins to activate. coach = best-practice advice, pagexray = request/asset analysis.

budget._comment: Performance budget file. Tests will fail if thresholds are exceeded.

html._comment: Generate an HTML report in the output folder.
